inputs.style: Heavy 1980s metal, thick crunchy distorted rhythm guitars, fluid virtuoso lead, forceful characterful male rock singing, thundering drums and bass. 148 BPM, B minor. a swaggering chromatic riff; call-and-answer solo passages and a huge minor-key chorus. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Crown of iron, heavy on my head
Built my throne on words the dead never said
Gold and glass, the windows start to crack
I hear the whisper, I hear the attack

[Chorus]
King of empty rooms
Shadows where the sun has gone
Every breath I take
Is a debt that I can't pay

[Verse]
Towers rise, the mountains fall
I signed the treaties, I broke them all
The tapestries are torn and red
The hollow halls are filled with dead

[Chorus]
King of empty rooms
Shadows where the sun has gone
Every breath I take
Is a debt that I can't pay

[Verse]
The final guest arrives with hollow eyes
Sitting cross-legged in the velvet lies
He taps his fingers on the oak
The throne splits down the center block
I scream but my mouth is gone
Devoured by the debt I've long worn
Now I sit beneath my own decree
A ghost feeding on my memory
The crown rolls off, the floor is bare
I am the empty room that's there
Silence swallows the iron weight
No shadow left to haunt the gate

[Bridge]
Screaming through the stone walls
The price of power, the loss of all
My hands are stained, my eyes are blind
Leaving all the living behind

[Solo]

[Chorus]
King of empty rooms
Shadows where the sun has gone
Every breath I take
Is a debt that I can't pay

[Outro]
The doors are locked
The echoes stop
King of nothing
On the edge of the rope
